item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":18,"statement":"LM.forward switches request transport entirely by model_type: chat selects litellm_completion, text selects litellm_text_completion, and responses selects litellm_responses_completion, using a request built from model, messages, and merged kwargs.","span_ids":["s1"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":14,"statement":"In chat mode, DSPy sends the request through litellm.completion with the chat messages payload still present; it removes rollout_id and handles headers separately before forwarding the rest of the request.","span_ids":["s1","s2"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":24,"statement":"In text mode, DSPy collapses message contents into one prompt string by joining them with blank lines and appending \"BEGIN RESPONSE:\", then rewrites the model name to text-completion-openai/<model>.","span_ids":["s3"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"core","weight":16,"statement":"In text mode, DSPy derives the provider from the model prefix (defaulting to openai) and resolves api_key and api_base from explicit request values first, otherwise from <provider>_API_KEY and <provider>_API_BASE.","span_ids":["s3"]},{"claim_id":"c5","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"In responses mode, DSPy converts a chat-style request into a Responses API request by replacing messages with an input payload of content blocks, turning string content into input_text blocks and converting list items before calling litellm.responses.","span_ids":["s4","s5"]},{"claim_id":"c6","claim_type":"supporting","weight":8,"statement":"Caller-supplied headers are forwarded after being merged with a default User-Agent of DSPy/<version>, and the completion helpers pass that merged header dict to LiteLLM.","span_ids":["s6","s7"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"s1","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":165,"end_line":190},{"span_id":"s2","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":385,"end_line":398},{"span_id":"s3","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":403,"end_line":430},{"span_id":"s4","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":479,"end_line":492},{"span_id":"s5","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":511,"end_line":529},{"span_id":"s6","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":589,"end_line":594},{"span_id":"s7","path":"dspy/clients/lm.py","start_line":385,"end_line":492}]}
